name: Yoshioka Keiichirou
source:
Yoshioka is the private secretary to Kurosaki, who supports him in any of his ventures without fail: including those ventures that involve bringing misfortune on innocent men for Kurosaki's pleasure. Despite the closeness between him and Kurosaki, they have never had sexual relations with each other.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/oreshita/oreshita.php]Boys' Love Game Headquarters[/url]]
